title: PCV Theory Test Explained: Bus and Coach Drivers
excerpt: Multiple choice, hazard perception, and Driver CPC case studies if you drive professionally.
description: The PCV (bus and coach) theory test explained: multiple-choice questions, hazard perception, Driver CPC case studies, pass marks and how to prepare.
body:
To drive a bus or coach, you need to pass the PCV theory test. It has a multiple-choice part and a hazard perception part, and professional drivers also need the Driver CPC case studies.

## Multiple-choice questions

- 100 questions in 1 hour 55 minutes
- Pass mark: 85 out of 100
- Topics include drivers' hours, carrying passengers, vehicle condition and braking systems

## Hazard perception

- 19 video clips
- Pass mark: 67 out of 100

## Driver CPC case studies

- Needed if you drive a bus or coach for a living
- Questions are based on real-life driving scenarios

## How to prepare

- Study each topic, paying extra attention to passenger safety and drivers' hours
- Take full-length mock tests so the long multiple-choice part feels normal
- Practise hazard perception clips regularly

Your pass certificate is valid for 2 years. Check GOV.UK for current rules and fees before booking. Try a free PCV mock test below.
